tenderSchedule.title: Selection of an Agency to Design, Develop, Test, Deploy, Operate, and Maintain Karnataka MSME Portal
tenderSchedule.description: Selection of an Agency to Design, Develop, Test, Deploy, Operate, and Maintain Karnataka MSME Portal
tenderSchedule.locationName: Karnataka Council for Technological Upgradation Head Office Bengaluru

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Conference Room, Department of Industries and Commerce, Government of Karnataka, First Floor, Khanija Bhavan (South Block), Racecourse Road, Bengaluru 560 001

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per tender document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Overall Experience with Government Portal Development Experience- The Bidder should have successfully completed the implementation of a minimum2(two)assignments of Web Portal/Application development including design / re-design/updating/augmentation in the last 7 years preceding the proposal due date with total assignment value not less than INR 2Crore (Two Crore) for each assignment. The Assignment must have been in India for any State or Central Government department or its agencies or PSUs, For1(one)such assignments-10 marks, For3(Three)such assignments - 20marks

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Supporting documents to be uploaded as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Overall Experience with Operation and Maintenance Services - The Bidder should have successfully completed a minimum of 1 (One) assignments in providing Operation & Maintenance(O&M)support for a Web Portal/Application, including manpower and solution support in the last 5 years preceding the proposal due date with assignment value not less than INR 25 Lakhs for assignment with a minimum durationof1(one)year,i.e.,12 twelve) months. The Assignment must have been in India for any State or Central Government department or its agencies or PSUs or for any private organization. For 2 (Two) such assignments - 10marks, For 4(two)such assignments - 20marks

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Supporting documents to be uploaded as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience with Development Web Application VAPT Experience - The Bidder should have successfully under taken the development of a Web Application VAPT Experience in the last 5 years preceding the proposal due date with assignment value not less than INR 5 Lakhs (Five Lakhs) for each assignment. The Assignment must have been in India for any State or Central Government department or its agencies or PSUs or for any private organization. For2(two)such assignment - 05marks, For2(two)such assignment - 10marks

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Supporting documents to be uploaded as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience with Development of Scheme Management Experience - The Bidder should have successfully undertaken the development of Scheme Management Experience in the last 5 years preceding the proposal due date with assignment value not less than INR 5Crore (Five Crore) for each assignment. The Assignment must have been in India for any State or Central Government department or its agencies or PSUs or for any private organization. For1(one)such assignment - 10 marks

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Supporting documents to be uploaded as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience in Government Integration Experience - The Bidder should have successfully executed projects involving Government integrating Government applications with at least five services such as Aadhaar, DigiLocker, eSign, Single Sign-On (SSO), SMS Gateway, Email Gateway, Payment Gateway, API Gateway or GIS.in the last 5 years preceding the proposal due date. The Assignment must have been in India for any State or Central Government department or its agencies or PSUs, For1(one)such assignment - 10marks

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Supporting documents to be uploaded as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience of the Bidder - Demonstration of experience with similar assignments done for Government sector clients - 2 marks, One Case study of how the bidder was able to improve the quality of digital services including the development and implementation of SEO strategy for one of its government sector clients(Central Government, State Government, or their undertakings) - 2 marks, One case study of experience developing AI based Applications - 1.5 marks, Case study of experience developing Web Portal/Application conforming to PWA & RWD, rendered on mobile and handheld devices - 1.5 marks

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Supporting documents to be uploaded as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Understanding of Assignment - Understanding of the objectives of the assignment and the client requirements - 2 marks

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Supporting documents to be uploaded as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Approach of the Bidder for Karnataka MSME Portal - High-level strategy for providing digital services as part of the Karnataka MSME Portal project - 4marks, Approach for providing reporting, dashboards, and management insights for the implementation of digital services - 4 marks, Approach for using relevant AI based technology and tools for accelerating Web Portal/Application development - 2 marks, Approach to address Non - functional Requirements - 2marks, Samples of user interface, user experience, and user journey for the Karnataka MSME Portal - 3 marks, Samples of various dashboards as per scope of work - 3marks
